lane: H77L: LiDAR micro-scarp with strike-normal spatially lagged ThK rank-intensity flank contrast
assignment_irregularity: The supplied brief has no identifiable standalone single method paragraph; this is a new self-declared narrow lane. Earlier H77, H77D, H77-Step, H78, LIA, contactphys are closed and are not retrained or edited.
inputs: data/raw/external/lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif: step_max band 3, coh100 band 10, valid band 12 (owner mirror of 3DEP derivatives)
data/raw/external/geodawn_extensions_u8.tif: ThK band 1 (owner quantized mirror of GeoDAWN data)
data/bridge/existing_faults.tif: component split, visible fault masking and final excluded catalogue ONLY
feature_units: uint8 percentile-quantized, 0=missing: normalized rank-intensity response only, no chemical concentration or heat evidence

method.lag_response: max(abs(ThK_smooth(x+3n)-ThK_smooth(x)), abs(ThK_smooth(x-3n)-ThK_smooth(x))) - 1.25 * (2*abs(grad_ThK_smooth dot n)); floor at 0; n = maximum-eigenvector of 2.5px-smoothed structure tensor of 1.3px-smoothed lidar step_max, with eigenvalue anisotropy as weight
method.surface_normalization: For each tested arm independently: threshold 99th percentile of strictly positive responses in eligible non-catalogue-independent footprint and scale by 99.9th minus 99th percentile, clip to [0,1]. Threshold/scale use covariates only. Zero outside eligible. No other tuning on labels.
method.mask_support: eligible = sample-footprint & lidar_valid>0 & lidar_step>0 & ThK>0, then square 3x3 erosion 16 iterations. No full-catalogue mask or truth in the response itself. Filter and 3px interpolation stencils are contained in eroded domain.

non_fault_mimic: road/canal embankments and Pleistocene lake shoreline benches at alluvial compositional boundaries
experiment_plan: One experiment: test every feature alone with AUC canaries and shared pooled hide-and-recover DTI on four fixed quadrant/whole-component folds; 80px training buffer; catalogue-derived quantities are only fold visible masks; negative proxies are unverified absence. Bootstrap aligned 20km blocks (1000 paired draws). Compare signal to control lidar_step with identical normalization. Surface uniqueness checked with unmodified pinned shared gate against at least two hash-verified pinned registry rasters. On first duplicate: STOP before placement, publish only the tested surface as a RESEARCH-ONLY file through unmodified shared writer with explicit NOT OK TO SUBMIT. Post-write compare exact decoded bytes to the same witnesses; do not present that as a dot-placement clearance.
promotion_rule: No competition slot without (i) every canary AUC <=0.90 (ii) complete unique registry surface and dots <= limits (iii) paired 95% CI of comparable holdout improvement above zero AND beat the current comparable holdout best (iv) local writer PASS (v) separate selector approval. A full incumbent is not re-fit here: no claim of beatability if fold domains differ.
registry_policy: Literal: correlation >0.90 or forward dot overlap >0.70 is a duplicate; no filtering of dense rasters, no density exemption, no private fork or reinterpretation. Partial scan proves rejection but cannot establish universal uniqueness.
organizer_authentication: owner-mirrored inputs and known leaderboard mapping, not an organizer-authenticated H33 receipt
expected_improvement: ordinal, uncertain; no projection or numerical score
